title: No agent: the speaker sounds unfinished
about: When Decider says the latest speaker has not finished, the gate waits for 1.2 s of silence before it raises a wrong claim.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: The orders DB is fine, CPU is normal.

lines.speaker: Mei
lines.text: So if the database is not the problem, then
lines.why: Decider says Mei has not finished: the floor opens on 1.2 s of silence, not before
